caption:
Global Metadata: A vibrant, communal West African drum piece, 112 BPM, full of joyful energy. Led by an ensemble of hand drums: a djembe (goblet drum) with sharp slaps and deep bass tones, a talking drum and shakers. A group of voices sings a call-and-response chant in a West African language, clapping and stamping add to the groove. It opens with the djembe solo setting the rhythm, the other drums and voices join in a full communal groove, a solo voice leads a call answered by the chorus, the drums build to a joyful peak, then end on a crisp decisive drum hit. Production profile: vivid, close, energetic drum recording, warm woody djembe tones, crisp slaps, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: A lead male voice sings a joyful call, answered by a group chorus of voices in call-and-response. Natural, raw, expressive, no auto-tune. The singing is rhythmic and celebratory. No spoken dialogue.

Arrangement: Intro, a solo djembe sets the rhythm with sharp slaps and deep bass tones. Section one, the other hand drums and shakers join in a full communal groove. Section two, a lead voice sings a joyful call, the chorus answers in call-and-response over the drums. Section three, the drums build to a joyful peak. Outro, a crisp decisive drum hit ends the piece.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Solo djembe sets the rhythm, sharp slaps and deep bass tones

[Section 1]
Hand drums and shakers join in a full communal groove

[Section 2]
He-ey, he-ey! Oya we go dance
oway, oway! the drums will lead us on
He-ey! kan iba, wabo
every heart is beating strong

[Section 3]
The drums build to a joyful peak

[Outro]
A crisp decisive drum hit ends the piece
